paper_title: Measurement of light-by-light scattering and search for axion-like particles with 2.2 nb$^{-1}$ of Pb+Pb data with the ATLAS detector
notes: ATLAS Pb+Pb light-by-light scattering search for axion-like particles via gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma. The result is presented as 95% CL limits on the ALP coupling 1/Lambda_a (TeV^-1) vs ALP mass m_a (6-100 GeV). Limits on 1/Lambda_a range from 0.3 TeV^-1 (at low mass) to 0.06 TeV^-1 (at high mass). This is an ALP-photon coupling (related to g_agamma by g_agamma = 1/Lambda_a). No numerical table of individual (mass, coupling) points is provided in the text; only the overall range is quoted and the curve is shown in Figures 9/10. Note the coupling here is given as 1/Lambda_a in TeV^-1 rather than g_agamma in GeV^-1; conversion: 0.3 TeV^-1 = 3e-4 GeV^-1, 0.06 TeV^-1 = 6e-5 GeV^-1. No extractable point-by-point data available, so data_points left empty.
